+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8a80
+title: 'swebench_score.py: the submitted count is wrong with --instance-ids'
+---
+`bench/swebench_score.py` with `--instance-ids` and an existing `--run-id` prints a wrong submitted count. On 2026-10-06 the command
+
+```
+uv run bench/swebench_score.py bench/preds.code-context-1006.jsonl --run-id score_20261006_143842 --instance-ids django__django-14608 django__django-14667 django__django-14672
+```
+
+printed `resolved=12 evaluated=15 ... submitted=3 percent_of_submitted=400.0`. The tally of 12/15 is correct, because `tally()` reads every `report.json` of the run. But the submitted count is the number of the `--instance-ids`, not the number of predictions in the file (16).
+
+Fix: the submitted count is the number of predictions in the file, and the percent of submitted uses that number.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The resumed score above prints `submitted=16` and a percent of submitted that is not more than 100.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] A unit test in `bench/test_*.py` gives a predictions file of 16 rows and 3 `--instance-ids`, and checks the submitted count.
+
+#bench
\ No newline at end of file
